origin.description: Report whether an object is an error.
origin.details: True only for an error condition.
origin.example:
cat("An error is an error:", is.error(simpleError("a")), "\n")
cat("A warning is not:", is.error(simpleWarning("a")), "\n")

translation.details: True only for an error condition.
translation.example:
